Use the interFoam solver (VOF method) for the classic 2D dam-break simulation, replacing the original twoPhaseEulerFoam application in system/controlDict with interFoam.
Build a 2D mesh in the x-y plane and extrude it one cell thick in the z direction using extrudeMesh, with the frontAndBack patches set to type empty so the case behaves as a 2D simulation.
Define the tank domain extent as 4 meters in the x direction and 4 meters in the y direction, matching the classic OpenFOAM damBreak tutorial geometry.
Define the initial water column as the region 0 ≤ x ≤ 1 m and 0 ≤ y ≤ 2 m, located flush against the left wall of the tank.
Use the setFields utility to initialize the volume fraction field alpha.water so that it equals 1 inside the specified water column region and 0 everywhere else in the domain.
Configure the case so that the resulting setup corresponds to the standard OpenFOAM damBreak tutorial located at $FOAM_TUTORIALS/multiphase/interFoam/laminar/damBreak, with the water column collapsing under gravity into the surrounding air through a sharp free surface captured by the VOF alpha.water field.
